title: Pricing a Conditioning Day by Its Length — Work Conditioning and Work Hardening
content:
# Pricing a conditioning day by its length

A program day of the Work Conditioning Program or the Work Hardening Program under a Workers' Compensation Referral is billed on the program hours recorded for that date of service. Its conditioning amount is priced by the length of the conditioning day:

- **six (6) or more conditioning hours** are billed as the two-hour initial block at a flat one hundred forty dollars ($140.00) plus every further conditioning hour at the conditioning hourly rate;
- **three (3) to five conditioning hours** are billed at the conditioning hourly rate for every hour, the day's conditioning amount being capped at three hundred dollars ($300.00);
- **fewer than three conditioning hours** are billed at the conditioning hourly rate for every hour with no cap.

The program hours of the day are those recorded on the referral for that date of service.

## Price bands

| Conditioning hours | Conditioning amount |
|---|---|
| 0 to 2 | the conditioning hourly rate for each hour, no cap |
| 3 to 5 | the conditioning hourly rate for each hour, but not more than $300.00 |
| 6 or more | $140.00 for the first two hours, plus the conditioning hourly rate for each hour beyond two |

## Worked figures (hypothetical conditioning hourly rate of $64.00)

| Conditioning hours | Working | Conditioning amount |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 2 hours at $64.00 | $128.00 |
| 4 | 4 hours at $64.00 is $256.00, under the $300.00 cap | $256.00 |
| 5 | 5 hours at $64.00 is $320.00, held to the cap | $300.00 |
| 6 | $140.00 for the first two hours, plus 4 hours at $64.00 ($256.00) | $396.00 |
| 8 | $140.00 for the first two hours, plus 6 hours at $64.00 ($384.00) | $524.00 |

## Edges

- 2 conditioning hours: no cap. 3 hours: the $300.00 cap applies.
- 5 conditioning hours: hourly with the cap. 6 hours: the two-hour block pricing.
